page.layout: One block of text in a single column; a dedication heading at the top in several lines, then the body with a decorated initial; catchword-style word "mul-" and page number "2" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Ornatissimis Viris - Juvenibus, S. MINISTERII CANDIDATIS dignissimis, & S. THEOLOGIÆ STUDIOSIS strenuissimis, magnam Ecclesiæ exspectationem fustinentibus; Aliisque, Veritatem, quæ secundùm Pietatem est, serio amantibus; Auditoribus dilectissimis, Lectoribus benevolis; ἰυπεχίτἑαν !
main_text.p: SPectaculum non minùs jucundum, quàm multis nominibus utile, exhibent Artifices: qui suis Tabulis accuratè delineant, & quibusvis facili intuitu lustrandum præbent, universum hunc, quem calcamus, orbem: ejusque zonas & climata, cum suis regnis, provinciis, ditionibus, omni continente, insulis, peninsulis, promontoriis, urbibus celebrioribus, &c. necnon tractûs maris, freta, flumina, &c. quin etiàm, quicquid in singulis majori admiratione dignum occurrit, annotant eâdem operâ. Hæc illi copiosiùs præstant suis Globis & Mappis grandibus, mul-

page.notes: The opening word "Pectaculum" carries a large decorative woodcut initial "S" which is joined to it; the printed word is "Spectaculum", read here as the initial plus "pectaculum". Greek line "ἰυπεχίτἑαν" is as printed and uncertain. Some letters in the body are faint: "lustrandum" reads as printed.
